$comment: Cloudberry Fen for T3 Code. Cloudberry tint of Fen: dark, neutrals leaned toward cloudberry (base #553524). Generated by build.mjs from src/ports/t3code.json. Do not edit ports/t3code/. Install: copy this file into ~/.t3/userdata/themes/ (or the themes folder under a custom T3 Code state directory); the folder is watched by the desktop app's local environment and the theme appears under Settings > Appearance without a restart. The file name is the theme id, so keep it as cloudberry-fen.json; nothing is renamed and no version is bumped. Settings > Appearance > Import theme accepts the same file pasted in. Needs T3 Code 0.0.40 or newer, where the 57-key list was verified; the list is unchanged through 0.0.45 and main, and an older build that lacks a key rejects the whole file rather than dropping the key, so there is no partial state to guard. No environment is needed: colours are CSS. One file is one appearance (dark), with no variants block, because the app already lets the reader pick a theme per appearance. Left unset because the app does not expose them: syntax colours (Shiki highlights code blocks from its own theme per appearance) and the terminal's sixteen ANSI colours (only background, foreground, cursor, selection and scrollbar are keys). Host-owned pairings, measured with lib/color.mjs contrast() as Wisp / Fen / Mire / Blackwater: sidebarForeground (ui.text) is drawn over every sidebar row state, so sidebarRowSelected is ui.selection rather than ui.fill, 7.66 / 6.60 / 9.29 / 10.57; ui.text on surface0 (hover rows, controls, the message bubble) 7.38 / 7.62 / 12.03 / 13.15; ui.text on surface1 (the accentSurface hover fill) 6.23 / 6.10 / 10.70 / 11.70; the alert body is drawn by the app at 80% alpha of errorForeground on errorSurface and sits under 4.5 on Fen whatever the theme does. Differs from Catppuccin (no catppuccin/t3code exists; the reference is the community file themes/catppuccin-mocha.json in SunkenInTime/t3-themes at e3022c7b): errorForeground and warningForeground are the status colours as text, not base on a full fill, and the status surfaces are 6% tints (ui.error.surface and kin), not the status colour itself; the sidebar is ui.pane.secondary and the terminal ui.background, not crust; hover and selected rows are a surface step and ui.selection, not three surface steps; the accent surface is surface1 under ui.text, not the accent under base; update follows ui.info, not the accent; focus is ui.focus; messageActionHover is ui.fill itself, because the send button's text is white in three flavours and crust in Fen, so no single shade of jam stays readable in all four (the notes file records the measurements).
name: Cloudberry Fen
